description: Source code for a wizard interface in OpenERP/Odoo, handling system setup and configuration through forms and methods.

classes.name: wizard_base_setup
classes.description: Wizard interface class for system setup, including methods for retrieving profiles, company info, updating configurations, and navigation.

methods.name: _get_profiles
methods.description: Retrieves available profile modules for setup.

methods.name: _get_all
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve all records of a given model.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates company and partner information based on form data.

methods.name: _menu
methods.description: Sets user menu actions to the setup menu.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Determines next step based on profile selection.

methods.name: _previous
methods.description: Determines previous step based on profile selection.
